name: Kusanagi Nobara
source:
She is the daughter of a wealthy family that has existed since the Meiji era.
Her father is a famous musician. Her mother is the daughter of a noble family. She will eventually succeed her grandfather as the head of the Kusanagi Group, and she is making every effort to become worthy of her position.

She is secretly proud of her high status and is accustomed to being in a position to use others. Because of this, she tends to unconsciously look down on people of ordinary blood and servants.

She has a faint crush on a childhood friend of the same age, but her pride gets in the way and she is unable to be honest with him.

She has a secret complex about her small breasts. She hates dogs. Just looking at them gives her a chill down her spine.

She is coerced into slavery by the protagonist, who threatens her on the basis of her family's wrongdoings. She is determined not to give in to the hero's cruelty.

[Translated from the [url=http://clockup.entacom.net/product/ryoujyoku/character.htm]official website[/url]]
